|game_text=Adds 3 to power of any starship he pilots. On Rogue 3, also adds 2 to maneuver and draws one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. May use 2 Force to search your Reserve Deck and take one One More Pass into hand. Shuffle, cut and replace.
